name: אָסָף
summary: Psalm 50 bears Asaph’s name. David appoints Asaph son of Berechiah to lead musicians before the ark. Other passages name an ancestor of a returning Levite, the father of Joah the recorder and a keeper of the king’s forest. The name has the consonants of the verb meaning gather.
note: The four TIPNR records distinguish bearers or identifications. No verse explains the original naming.
